summary: This table presents a comparison of growth percentages, specifically quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) and year-over-year (YoY) growth, across two categories: Reported and Constant Currency (CC). The QoQ growth is shown as 0.9% for Reported and 1.7% for CC, while the YoY growth is 5.9% for Reported and 6.1% for CC. This data highlights the differences in growth rates when considering reported figures versus those adjusted for constant currency, providing insights into financial performance over different time frames.
